slides.title: Built different,
slides.description: The principles behind Mossaic's products and engineering work: focused tools, thoughtful compliance, explainable AI, and infrastructure grounded in India.
points: Modular by default — add what is needed, without forced feature bloat.
Compliance built in — consent, audit trails, and data locality are part of the foundation.
Explainable, not opaque — where AI is used, show its working.
India-first architecture — rupee pricing, India-region hosting, and GST-ready billing.
